provenance_quote: The Burkholderia BipC protein is homologous to the Salmonella SipC and Shigella IpaC T3SS proteins, and is secreted by the Bsa T3SS
notes: Secretion confirmed via full text (Vander Broek 2017, PMID 28770177, DOI 10.3389/fcimb.2017.00333) which states BipC is secreted by the Bsa T3SS and is annotated BPSS1531 in K96243. Ledger uniprot A0A8A4DTS9 is a DELETED UniProt record (Not part of a reference proteome). Current BipC accession in K96243 is Q63K35 (BIPC_BURPS, gene bipC BPSS1531, RefSeq WP_004203135.1). Ledger locus BPS_RS27060 could not be independently confirmed via NCBI (no hits) but BipC=BPSS1531 on NC_006351.1; effector identity solid.

provenance_quote: Eight of these Ysps (YspK, YspI, YspE, YspF, YspP, YspY, YspN and YspL) had not previously been characterized ... resulted in Ysa T3S system-dependent increases in cytosolic levels of cAMP for six Ysps (YspK, YspI, YspE, YspF, YspP and YspL)

notes: Abstract of Tu et al 2003 (PMID 12535063, DOI 10.1046/j.1365-2958.2003.03329.x) confirms EspH translocated by the TTSS. UniProt B7UMA2 = LEE-encoded effector EspH, E. coli O127:H6 E2348/69 (EPEC); matches gene EspH, organism, locus E2348C, genome NC_011601.1. Confirmed.
